+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 基础指标类
+ 所有周期指标的基类
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ from typing import List, Dict, Any
+ from collections import deque
+ 
+ 
+ class BaseIndicator:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;基础指标计算器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     def __init__(self, timeframe: str, window_size: int = 1000):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         初始化指标计算器
+         
+         Args:
+             timeframe: 时间周期标识 (如 &quot;1m&quot;, &quot;5m&quot;, &quot;1h&quot;, &quot;4h&quot;)
+             window_size: 数据缓存窗口大小
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.timeframe = timeframe
+         self.window_size = window_size
+         self.data_buffer = deque(maxlen=window_size)
+         
+     def update_bar(self, bar):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         更新K线数据
+         
+         Args:
+             bar: K线数据对象（需包含 open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume）
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.data_buffer.append(bar)
+         
+     def calculate_indicators(self, bar) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         计算技术指标
+         
+         Args:
+             bar: 当前K线数据
+             
+         Returns:
+             dict: 指标字典
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.update_bar(bar)
+         
+         if len(self.data_buffer) &lt; 20:  # 最小数据量要求
+             return {}
+         
+         # 子类需要实现具体的指标计算逻辑
+         return {}
+     
+     def clear(self):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;清空数据缓存&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.data_buffer.clear()
+     
+     def write_log(self, msg: str):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;写日志（可在子类中重写以接入日志系统）&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         print(f&quot;[{self.timeframe}] {msg}&quot;)
+ 
```

+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 1分钟周期指标模块
+ 专门处理1分钟级别的技术指标计算
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ import talib
+ import numpy as np
+ from typing import Dict, Any
+ from .base_indicator import BaseIndicator
+ 
+ 
+ class Minute1Indicators(BaseIndicator):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;1分钟周期指标计算器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     def __init__(self):
+         super().__init__(&quot;1m&quot;, window_size=500)
+         
+         # 快速指标参数（1分钟周期使用较短周期）
+         self.ma_periods = [5, 10, 20]
+         self.ema_periods = [12, 26]
+         self.macd_params = (12, 26, 9)
+         self.rsi_period = 14
+         
+     def calculate_indicators(self, bar) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;计算1分钟周期的技术指标&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.update_bar(bar)
+         
+         if len(self.data_buffer) &lt; 30:  # 1分钟周期需要较少数据
+             return {}
+         
+         # 提取OHLCV数据
+         closes = np.array([b.close_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         highs = np.array([b.high_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         lows = np.array([b.low_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         volumes = np.array([b.volume for b in self.data_buffer])
+         
+         indicators = {}
+         
+         try:
+             # 快速移动平均线
+             for period in self.ma_periods:
+                 if len(closes) &gt;= period:
+                     ma_value = talib.SMA(closes, period)[-1]
+                     indicators[f&#39;ma{period}&#39;] = ma_value
+             
+             # MACD
+             if len(closes) &gt;= self.macd_params[1] + self.macd_params[2]:
+                 macd, signal, hist = talib.MACD(closes, *self.macd_params)
+                 indicators[&#39;macd&#39;] = macd[-1] if not np.isnan(macd[-1]) else 0
+                 indicators[&#39;macd_signal&#39;] = signal[-1] if not np.isnan(signal[-1]) else 0
+                 indicators[&#39;macd_hist&#39;] = hist[-1] if not np.isnan(hist[-1]) else 0
+             
+             # RSI
+             if len(closes) &gt;= self.rsi_period:
+                 rsi = talib.RSI(closes, self.rsi_period)[-1]
+                 indicators[&#39;rsi&#39;] = rsi
+             
+             # 价格和成交量
+             indicators[&#39;price&#39;] = closes[-1]
+             indicators[&#39;volume&#39;] = volumes[-1]
+             
+         except Exception as e:
+             self.write_log(f&quot;1分钟指标计算错误: {e}&quot;)
+             
+         return indicators
+ 
```

+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 1小时周期指标模块
+ 专门处理1小时级别的技术指标计算
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ import talib
+ import numpy as np
+ from typing import Dict, Any
+ from .base_indicator import BaseIndicator
+ 
+ 
+ class Hour1Indicators(BaseIndicator):
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;1小时周期指标计算器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     def __init__(self):
+         super().__init__(&quot;1h&quot;, window_size=500)
+         
+         # 指标参数配置
+         self.ma_periods = [10, 20, 60]
+         self.ema_periods = [12, 26]
+         self.macd_params = (12, 26, 9)
+         self.rsi_period = 14
+         
+     def calculate_indicators(self, bar) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;计算1小时周期的技术指标&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.update_bar(bar)
+         
+         if len(self.data_buffer) &lt; max(self.ma_periods):
+             return {}
+         
+         # 提取OHLCV数据
+         closes = np.array([b.close_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         highs = np.array([b.high_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         lows = np.array([b.low_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         volumes = np.array([b.volume for b in self.data_buffer])
+         
+         indicators = {}
+         
+         try:
+             # 移动平均线
+             for period in self.ma_periods:
+                 if len(closes) &gt;= period:
+                     ma_value = talib.SMA(closes, period)[-1]
+                     indicators[f&#39;ma{period}&#39;] = ma_value
+             
+             # MACD
+             if len(closes) &gt;= self.macd_params[1] + self.macd_params[2]:
+                 macd, signal, hist = talib.MACD(closes, *self.macd_params)
+                 indicators[&#39;macd&#39;] = macd[-1] if not np.isnan(macd[-1]) else 0
+                 indicators[&#39;macd_signal&#39;] = signal[-1] if not np.isnan(signal[-1]) else 0
+                 indicators[&#39;macd_hist&#39;] = hist[-1] if not np.isnan(hist[-1]) else 0
+                 
+                 # MACD趋势判断
+                 if len(hist) &gt;= 2:
+                     indicators[&#39;macd_trend&#39;] = 1 if hist[-1] &gt; hist[-2] else -1
+             
+             # RSI
+             if len(closes) &gt;= self.rsi_period:
+                 rsi = talib.RSI(closes, self.rsi_period)[-1]
+                 indicators[&#39;rsi&#39;] = rsi
+             
+             # ADX (趋势强度)
+             if len(closes) &gt;= 14:
+                 adx = talib.ADX(highs, lows, closes, 14)[-1]
+                 indicators[&#39;adx&#39;] = adx if not np.isnan(adx) else 0
+             
+             # 支撑阻力位
+             if len(highs) &gt;= 20:
+                 indicators[&#39;resistance&#39;] = np.max(highs[-20:])
+                 indicators[&#39;support&#39;] = np.min(lows[-20:])
+             
+         except Exception as e:
+             self.write_log(f&quot;1小时指标计算错误: {e}&quot;)
+             
+         return indicators
+ 
```

+ import talib

+ class Hour4Indicators(BaseIndicator):

+         self.rsi_period = 14
+         
+     def calculate_indicators(self, bar) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;计算4小时周期的技术指标&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.update_bar(bar)
+         
+         if len(self.data_buffer) &lt; max(self.ma_periods):
+             return {}
+         
+         # 提取OHLCV数据
+         closes = np.array([b.close_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         highs = np.array([b.high_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         lows = np.array([b.low_price for b in self.data_buffer])
+         volumes = np.array([b.volume for b in self.data_buffer])
+         
+         indicators = {}
+         
+         try:
+             # 移动平均线
+             for period in self.ma_periods:

+                     ma_value = talib.SMA(closes, period)[-1]
+                     indicators[f&#39;ma{period}&#39;] = ma_value
+             
+             # 均线排列判断（重要趋势指标）
+             if all(f&#39;ma{p}&#39; in indicators for p in self.ma_periods):
+                 ma20, ma60, ma120 = [indicators[f&#39;ma{p}&#39;] for p in self.ma_periods]
+                 
+                 # 多头排列
+                 if ma20 &gt; ma60 &gt; ma120:
+                     indicators[&#39;ma_trend&#39;] = 1
+                     indicators[&#39;trend_strength&#39;] = (ma20 - ma120) / ma120 * 100
+                 # 空头排列
+                 elif ma20 &lt; ma60 &lt; ma120:
+                     indicators[&#39;ma_trend&#39;] = -1
+                     indicators[&#39;trend_strength&#39;] = (ma120 - ma20) / ma120 * 100
+                 else:
+                     indicators[&#39;ma_trend&#39;] = 0
+                     indicators[&#39;trend_strength&#39;] = 0
+             
+             # MACD

+                 indicators[&#39;macd_signal&#39;] = signal[-1] if not np.isnan(signal[-1]) else 0
+                 indicators[&#39;macd_hist&#39;] = hist[-1] if not np.isnan(hist[-1]) else 0
+                 
+                 # MACD趋势判断
+                 if len(hist) &gt;= 5:
+                     recent_hist = hist[-5:]
+                     if all(h &gt; 0 for h in recent_hist):
+                         indicators[&#39;macd_trend&#39;] = 1
+                     elif all(h &lt; 0 for h in recent_hist):
+                         indicators[&#39;macd_trend&#39;] = -1
+                     else:
+                         indicators[&#39;macd_trend&#39;] = 0
+             
+             # RSI
+             if len(closes) &gt;= self.rsi_period:
+                 rsi = talib.RSI(closes, self.rsi_period)[-1]
+                 indicators[&#39;rsi&#39;] = rsi
+                 
+                 # RSI超买超卖判断
+                 if rsi &gt; 70:
+                     indicators[&#39;rsi_signal&#39;] = -1  # 超买
+                 elif rsi &lt; 30:
+                     indicators[&#39;rsi_signal&#39;] = 1   # 超卖
+                 else:
+                     indicators[&#39;rsi_signal&#39;] = 0
+             
+             # ADX (趋势强度)
+             if len(closes) &gt;= 14:
+                 adx = talib.ADX(highs, lows, closes, 14)[-1]
+                 indicators[&#39;adx&#39;] = adx if not np.isnan(adx) else 0
+                 
+                 # ADX趋势强度判断
+                 if adx &gt; 25:
+                     indicators[&#39;trend_strong&#39;] = True
+                 else:
+                     indicators[&#39;trend_strong&#39;] = False
+             
+             # 支撑阻力位（更长周期）
+             if len(highs) &gt;= 50:
+                 indicators[&#39;resistance&#39;] = np.max(highs[-50:])
+                 indicators[&#39;support&#39;] = np.min(lows[-50:])
+                 indicators[&#39;channel_width&#39;] = indicators[&#39;resistance&#39;] - indicators[&#39;support&#39;]
+             
+         except Exception as e:
+             self.write_log(f&quot;4小时指标计算错误: {e}&quot;)
+             
+         return indicators
+ 
```

+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 多周期数据管理器
+ 负责管理不同时间周期的K线数据和技术指标
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
+ from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+ from collections import deque
+ 
+ from indicators import Minute1Indicators, Minute5Indicators, Hour1Indicators, Hour4Indicators
+ 
+ 
+ class TimeframeManager:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;多周期数据管理器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     def __init__(self):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;初始化多周期数据管理器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         # 初始化各周期指标计算器
+         self.minute1_indicators = Minute1Indicators()
+         self.minute5_indicators = Minute5Indicators()
+         self.hour1_indicators = Hour1Indicators()
+         self.hour4_indicators = Hour4Indicators()
+         
+         # 数据缓存（用于合成高周期K线）
+         self.minute1_bars = deque(maxlen=1000)
+         self.minute5_bars = deque(maxlen=500)
+         self.hour1_bars = deque(maxlen=500)
+         self.hour4_bars = deque(maxlen=500)
+         
+         # 最后更新的时间戳
+         self.last_update_time = None
+         
+     def update_1m_bar(self, bar) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         更新1分钟K线数据
+         
+         Args:
+             bar: 1分钟K线数据对象
+             
+         Returns:
+             dict: 包含所有周期指标的字典
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.minute1_bars.append(bar)
+         self.last_update_time = bar.datetime if hasattr(bar, &#39;datetime&#39;) else datetime.now()
+         
+         # 计算1分钟指标
+         indicators_1m = self.minute1_indicators.calculate_indicators(bar)
+         
+         # 尝试合成5分钟K线
+         bar_5m = self._try_synthesize_5m_bar()
+         indicators_5m = {}
+         if bar_5m:
+             self.minute5_bars.append(bar_5m)
+             indicators_5m = self.minute5_indicators.calculate_indicators(bar_5m)
+             
+             # 尝试合成1小时K线
+             bar_1h = self._try_synthesize_1h_bar()
+             indicators_1h = {}
+             if bar_1h:
+                 self.hour1_bars.append(bar_1h)
+                 indicators_1h = self.hour1_indicators.calculate_indicators(bar_1h)
+                 
+                 # 尝试合成4小时K线
+                 bar_4h = self._try_synthesize_4h_bar()
+                 indicators_4h = {}
+                 if bar_4h:
+                     self.hour4_bars.append(bar_4h)
+                     indicators_4h = self.hour4_indicators.calculate_indicators(bar_4h)
+         
+         # 汇总所有周期指标
+         all_indicators = {
+             &#39;1m&#39;: indicators_1m,
+             &#39;5m&#39;: indicators_5m,
+             &#39;1h&#39;: indicators_1h if &#39;indicators_1h&#39; in locals() else {},
+             &#39;4h&#39;: indicators_4h if &#39;indicators_4h&#39; in locals() else {},
+         }
+         
+         return all_indicators
+     
+     def _try_synthesize_5m_bar(self) -&gt; Optional[Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;尝试合成5分钟K线&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if len(self.minute1_bars) &lt; 5:
+             return None
+         
+         # 检查是否到了5分钟周期
+         recent_bars = list(self.minute1_bars)[-5:]
+         if not self._is_timeframe_complete(recent_bars, minutes=5):
+             return None
+         
+         # 合成5分钟K线
+         return self._synthesize_bar(recent_bars)
+     
+     def _try_synthesize_1h_bar(self) -&gt; Optional[Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;尝试合成1小时K线&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if len(self.minute5_bars) &lt; 12:  # 12 * 5分钟 = 60分钟
+             return None
+         
+         # 检查是否到了1小时周期
+         recent_bars = list(self.minute5_bars)[-12:]
+         if not self._is_timeframe_complete(recent_bars, minutes=60):
+             return None
+         
+         # 合成1小时K线
+         return self._synthesize_bar(recent_bars)
+     
+     def _try_synthesize_4h_bar(self) -&gt; Optional[Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;尝试合成4小时K线&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if len(self.hour1_bars) &lt; 4:
+             return None
+         
+         # 检查是否到了4小时周期
+         recent_bars = list(self.hour1_bars)[-4:]
+         if not self._is_timeframe_complete(recent_bars, minutes=240):
+             return None
+         
+         # 合成4小时K线
+         return self._synthesize_bar(recent_bars)
+     
+     def _is_timeframe_complete(self, bars: list, minutes: int) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;检查时间周期是否完整&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not bars:
+             return False
+         
+         # 简化版：检查最后一个bar的时间是否对齐到周期边界
+         last_bar = bars[-1]
+         if hasattr(last_bar, &#39;datetime&#39;):
+             dt = last_bar.datetime
+             # 检查分钟数是否能被周期整除
+             if isinstance(dt, datetime):
+                 return dt.minute % minutes == 0
+         
+         # 如果没有datetime属性，简单检查数量
+         return len(bars) &gt;= minutes
+     
+     def _synthesize_bar(self, bars: list) -&gt; Any:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;合成高周期K线&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not bars:
+             return None
+         
+         # 提取数据
+         opens = [b.open_price for b in bars]
+         highs = [b.high_price for b in bars]
+         lows = [b.low_price for b in bars]
+         closes = [b.close_price for b in bars]
+         volumes = [b.volume for b in bars if hasattr(b, &#39;volume&#39;)]
+         
+         # 创建合成的K线对象
+         synthesized_bar = type(bars[0])(
+             symbol=bars[0].symbol if hasattr(bars[0], &#39;symbol&#39;) else &#39;&#39;,
+             exchange=bars[0].exchange if hasattr(bars[0], &#39;exchange&#39;) else &#39;&#39;,
+             datetime=bars[-1].datetime if hasattr(bars[-1], &#39;datetime&#39;) else datetime.now(),
+             open_price=opens[0],
+             high_price=max(highs),
+             low_price=min(lows),
+             close_price=closes[-1],
+             volume=sum(volumes) if volumes else 0
+         )
+         
+         return synthesized_bar
+     
+     def get_all_indicators(self) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;获取所有周期的指标&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         return {
+             &#39;1m&#39;: self.minute1_indicators.calculate_indicators(
+                 self.minute1_bars[-1] if self.minute1_bars else None
+             ),
+             &#39;5m&#39;: self.minute5_indicators.calculate_indicators(
+                 self.minute5_bars[-1] if self.minute5_bars else None
+             ),
+             &#39;1h&#39;: self.hour1_indicators.calculate_indicators(
+                 self.hour1_bars[-1] if self.hour1_bars else None
+             ),
+             &#39;4h&#39;: self.hour4_indicators.calculate_indicators(
+                 self.hour4_bars[-1] if self.hour4_bars else None
+             ),
+         }
+     
+     def clear(self):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;清空所有数据&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         self.minute1_bars.clear()
+         self.minute5_bars.clear()
+         self.hour1_bars.clear()
+         self.hour4_bars.clear()
+         
+         self.minute1_indicators.clear()
+         self.minute5_indicators.clear()
+         self.hour1_indicators.clear()
+         self.hour4_indicators.clear()
+ 
```

## 已创建的模块

### 1. Indicator模块
- `indicators/base_indicator.py` - 基础指标类（所有指标的基类）
- `indicators/minute_1_indicators.py` - 1分钟周期指标计算器
- `indicators/hour_1_indicators.py` - 1小时周期指标计算器
- `indicators/hour_4_indicators.py` - 4小时周期指标计算器
- `indicators/minute_5_indicators.py` - 已存在（5分钟周期指标）

### 2. Data模块
- `data/__init__.py` - data模块初始化文件
- `data/timeframe_manager.py` - 多周期数据管理器（负责K线合成和指标管理）

### 3. 功能特性

所有模块都包含：
- 技术指标计算（MA, EMA, MACD, RSI, ADX等）
- 多周期数据管理（自动合成高周期K线）
- 错误处理和日志记录

## 现在可以运行了

python 完整集成示例.py

```
